# KINGAI | Public Business, Products and Solutions
Official company: KINGAIWORK LLC — registered in the United States
Official website: https://kingai.work
Business contact: vip@kingai.work
Public repository: https://github.com/kingaiwork/KINGAIASE-public

This repository publishes customer-facing information only:
- BUSINESS.md — what the company does and typical deliverables
- PRODUCTS.md — product purposes, links and actual public release boundaries
- SOLUTIONS.md — solutions for individuals, businesses, public institutions and cities
- README.md — short overview and official next step
- public-project-facts.json — structured public business, product and solution facts
- customer-knowledge.json — approved public answers about the above

Business categories:
- AI workforce and governed task automation
- Intelligent websites and applications
- Custom software, SaaS and enterprise management systems
- AI search visibility and digital growth
- Security and operational continuity
- Institutional and public-sector digital planning and integration

Public product examples:
- Wenshu Office — https://github.com/kingaiwork/Wenshu-Releases — public beta
- KINGAI OS — https://github.com/kingaiwork/KINGAI-OS-Releases — Desktop and Server developer previews
- KINGAI Global Intelligence — https://intel.kingai.work — public product
- KINGAI Online Tools — https://tools.kingai.work — browser tools
- Other KINGAI intelligent workforce, security, operations, customer systems and digital life directions: scope and availability must be confirmed through https://kingai.work

Solutions are organized by real customer problems. A roadmap is not a release and no unverified results, commercial prices, personal identities, detailed company registration or proprietary implementation are published here.
